name: Deore XT crankset
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed average 669 g for FC-M8000-B1, 170 mm crank arms and 30T chainrings, explicitly excluding the bottom bracket. This is the later 2025–2026 qualified 30T reference; the inconsistent earlier 36T weight entry is not used. The B1 crank has a 53.4 mm chainline, 3 mm outboard of the standard version.
